Game Overview

In Asteroid, the core idea is straightforward: navigate treacherous asteroid fields in a pulse-pounding space adventure. Master agile dodging, unleash powerful firepower, and collect upgrades to survive in Asteroid. Feel the adrenaline as meteorite waves intensify, testing your skills and reflexes. Every maneuver counts in this thrilling cosmic battle for survival. How long will you last?
